title: MV Making game mobile, is there a recommended UI buttons addon?

posts.author: SmirkSmileGrin_Games
posts.body: Hello, I am trying to make a PC game for android mobile and I was wondering if there is any recommended addon which will allow me to easily incorporate a touch screen/button interface into a turn based jrpg type game, which is modernly used with rpg maker MV and compatible with most addons?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Triacontane's PictureCallCommon is what I would use because it had transparency detection. Yanfly has one but it doesn't detect transparent pixels in the image.
RPGMakerMV/PictureCallCommon.js at master · triacontane/RPGMakerMV
